purpose: Run the governed symbolic review for Projection Legality and determine whether L099 may advance from SYMBOLIC_CHECK_READY to symbolic_checked.
governance_note: Passing this review only means the projection legality lemma is symbolically well-formed under declared definitions. It does not validate Pi_geo empirically, establish physical geometry, or unblock downstream application claims.

review_checks.name: Domain completeness
review_checks.pass_condition: Dom(Pi_geo) admits only T with complete Trace_geo(T) labels before projection.
review_checks.evidence: Dom(Pi_geo) admission_rule: 'T enters Dom(Pi_geo) only if all four labels are present and non-null in Trace_geo(T) prior to projection.' Trace_geo attachment_rule: 'No field may be inferred after projection.' Missing/null/conflicted labels exclude T from Dom. No post-projection inference pathway exists.

review_checks.name: Codomain containment
review_checks.pass_condition: Cod(Pi_geo) contains only G for which tau_geo(G) recovers all four labels. geometry_app not treated as physical space.
review_checks.evidence: Cod(Pi_geo) admission_rule requires all four labels recoverable by tau_geo without conflict or alias. forbidden_reading explicitly states Cod is NOT physical space, metric manifold, field content, or matter content. must_not_claim enumerates physical geometry, metric realism, field_app/matter_app support.

review_checks.name: Trace non-inversion
review_checks.pass_condition: tau_geo is a partial recoverability check only, not a full inverse of Pi_geo.
review_checks.evidence: tau_geo_undefined_conditions.definition: 'tau_geo is a partial recoverability operator.' TAU-UNDEF-1 through TAU-UNDEF-4 establish four classes of undefinedness — a total inverse would be defined everywhere. must_not_claim[0]: 'tau_geo is a full inverse of Pi_geo'. OBJ-GEO-TRACE-001 operator_note confirms: 'tau_geo is NOT a full inverse of Pi_geo.'

review_checks.name: Distinction preservation
review_checks.pass_condition: PO-GEO-001A active; distinction_alias failure mode not suppressed; ~_geo non-collapsing.
review_checks.evidence: PO-GEO-001A: current_status=explicit_defined, failure_active=true, failure_mode=distinction_alias. ~_geo equivalence_relation_declaration constraint: 'may not collapse T objects that are distinct under the Topology_app equivalence relation.' TAU-UNDEF-2 fires on missing distinction_class.

review_checks.name: Admissibility preservation
review_checks.pass_condition: PO-GEO-001B active; admissibility_violation not suppressed; FAIL-T blocked from Dom.
review_checks.evidence: PO-GEO-001B: current_status=explicit_defined, failure_active=true, failure_mode=admissibility_violation. Dom admission_rule excludes FAIL-admissibility T before projection begins. check_mechanism: 'A PASS-to-FAIL transition is a failure event.' No path where FAIL geometry_app is accepted.

review_checks.name: Orientation trace preservation
review_checks.pass_condition: PO-GEO-001C active; orientation_trace_loss not suppressed; loss renders Pi_geo inadmissible.
review_checks.evidence: PO-GEO-001C: current_status=explicit_defined, failure_active=true, failure_mode=orientation_trace_loss. check_mechanism: 'Any mismatch, null, or undefined return from tau_geo is a failure event (TAU-UNDEF-2).' TAU-UNDEF-2 consequence: 'Pi_geo is inadmissible for this input class.' No orientation loss silently accepted.

review_checks.name: Closure trace preservation
review_checks.pass_condition: PO-GEO-001D active; closure_trace_loss_or_alias not suppressed; mapping injective.
review_checks.evidence: PO-GEO-001D: current_status=explicit_defined, failure_active=true, failure_mode=closure_trace_loss_or_alias. Two-part check: (1) recovery equality; (2) injectivity across T objects. TAU-UNDEF-4 covers aliasing: 'PO-GEO-001D is failed. tau_geo is not injective on closure classes for this input pair.'

review_checks.name: No downstream leakage
review_checks.pass_condition: geometry_app remains C1_STRUCTURAL_PROJECTION_ONLY; field_app/matter_app/gravity_app remain blocked; symbolic_checked not used as application support.
review_checks.evidence: PO-GEO-001 promotion_gate: 'geometry_app remains C1_STRUCTURAL_PROJECTION_ONLY after symbolic_checked unless GEO-CAMPAIGN-001 also passes.' Caps from GEO_GAP_REDUCTION_SEQUENCE_001: field_app supports_blocked, matter_app supports_blocked, gravity_app REVIEW_LOCK — none modified by this review. L100 remains CONDITIONAL. No automatic propagation chain exists.

what_this_means.L099_symbolic_checked: The projection legality lemma is symbolically well-formed under the declared definitions. Pi_geo's domain, codomain, trace map, and all four invariant preservation checks are formally consistent within C1 scope.
what_it_does_not_mean: geometry_app has been promoted beyond C1
downstream application claims (field, matter, gravity) have been unblocked

remaining_gate.requirement: All four adversarial control runs must pass. Simulation evidence required.
remaining_gate.result_if_passed: geometry_app may be considered for advancement beyond C1_STRUCTURAL_PROJECTION_ONLY; further claim-level review required before any application support is restored.
